name: @dialecte/create
description: Scaffold and generate Dialecte SDKs from an XSD schema. Runs the Python generator in WebAssembly - no Python required.

scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint:check && npm run format:check
scripts.test:py: cd python && $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m pytest
scripts.mutants: cd python && $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m mutants.run
scripts.corpora:fetch: cd python && $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m corpora.fetch
scripts.test:corpora: cd python && PROOF_CORPORA=1 $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m pytest tests/corpora -q
scripts.fuzz: cd python && $(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) -m proof.fuzz
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run vendor && npm run build
